newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oil, Mitsubishi Oil to set up plant.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oil, Mitsubishi Oil to set up plant.

text.p: Thai Oil Co Ltd said on Monday that it had entered into a joint venture agreement with Mitsubishi Oil Corp of Japan to set up the first paraxylene production facility in Thailand.
The plant, which costs 7.0 billion baht ($269.2 million), will be located adjacent to the Thai Oil refinery in the eastern province of Chonburi, it said.
The semi-state owned Thai Oil said the plant will have a production capacity of 300,000 tonnes annually. Construction on the plant is scheduled to start in May and will be completed in 1999.

The plant will produce quality paraxylene as feedstock for pure terephthalic acid plants, which in turn is feedstock for the production of polyester fibres and polyethylene terphthalate bottles. By-products of the paraxylene plant are toluene, heavy aromatics and fuel gas, the company said.
Thai Oil will hold a 62 percent stake of the joint venture company named Thai Paraxylene Co Ltd, it said.
